summary.text: Tara Hallmark is a Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 124 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Hallmark, a farmer and Navy veteran, was the Democratic nominee for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Tara Hallmark was born in Pasadena, Texas, and served in the U.S. Navy from 1988 to 1989.
Her career experience includes working as a farmer, as a federal grant specialist, as a federal course writer, and in government and academic emergency response, planning and mitigation.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Hallmark said she grew up in San Antonio, Texas, joined the Navy after high school, and lives on a peach orchard and farm in rural Missouri.
Hallmark ran for District 124 in 2024, when incumbent Don Mayhew defeated her in the November 5 general election.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.
In her 2024 survey, Hallmark listed access to health care, including reproductive and mental health care, voting access, and keeping public tax money in public schools among her campaign messages.
